connector.name: Pacer MCP
connector.registryDescription: Pacer revenue-management API as MCP tools: portfolios, pacing, market metrics, Guesty, briefs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image pacer-mcp:1.0.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the str-consulting account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PACER_CORE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the pacer/core app (PAT JSON API). Defaults to production (portal.pacerrev.io).

env.name: PACER_CORE_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token (pat_...) issued via `pacer pat create`. Requires the employee role or higher.
